title: Book Two · Chapter 7: The Long Blue Cloth
story:
On Sunday, Mum puts a long blue cloth on the bed.

Ronan moves his book off the blanket. He watches the cloth spread across his usual reading place.

“Another bag?”

“A skirt for me.”

“For school?”

“For my legs,” Mum says.

Dad laughs from the doorway. Ronan moves farther back so Mum can measure the cloth.

One end has a pale line. Mum turns it over. The other side looks the same.

“Will you cut that off?” Ronan asks.

“I can put it inside.”

She folds the end and holds it against her waist. Dad tilts his head.

“Too long?”

“It is not cut yet.”

“Then it is very long.”

Mum drops the fold over his arm.

“You can hold this very long end.”

Dad holds it. Ronan puts his hand over his mouth. Mum looks at him and smiles.

After breakfast, she goes to buy thread. She also wants to see a friend near the cloth shop. Dad stays home to finish a small work page for Monday.

Ronan sits by the window with his book. He wants to read the whole page before Mum comes back.

He starts quickly. At the bottom, there is a boy with a basket. The words say the basket is empty.

Ronan goes back to the picture. There are round shapes beside the boy, on the ground.

He looks at the line again. The basket is empty now. The round things are already outside it.

He did not notice them at first.

Dad is adding a number on his page. Ronan waits, then points to the picture.

“Does this look full or empty?”

“Empty.”

“I thought the things were still inside.”

Dad moves the book closer. “The edge is here.”

He follows it with one finger. Ronan sees the gap now.

They look for the same basket on the next page. It is smaller there, but its shape is clear.

After a while, Ronan closes the book and goes outside. Jun comes to the gate with a little ball. They play in the clear part of the yard. Mrs Lan tells them to keep away from Mr Qiu's table.

They kick the ball to each other. Once, the ball rolls into a shoe. Neither boy can get it out at first. Jun shakes the shoe, and the ball drops behind his own leg.

Ronan laughs hard. He misses his next turn.

Mum returns near noon. There is no thread in her bag.

“The right blue was gone,” she says. “I can get it another day.”

“Is the skirt waiting?” Ronan asks.

“The cloth is waiting. I have other things to do.”

She hangs it safely inside. Then she sits in the yard with her cup. Dad brings a second chair.

Ronan puts his book away and joins them. Mum tells them about her friend. For a while, nobody asks him to read or count. He eats a piece of pear and listens.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

waist＝腰；thread＝线；empty＝空的；gap＝空隙。

## 理解问题

1. Mum为什么没有买到线？
2. Ronan为什么误看了篮子？

## 读句子

The basket / is empty / now.＝篮子／是空的／现在。
